regex_cons :: t0 -> list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_car :: list(t0) -> t0

regex_cdr :: list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_map :: (t0 -> t1) -> list(t0) -> list(t1)

replace_if_match_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match $1 $0) $2 $0)) (regex_split '.' $2))))))
description: A function that replaces a substring in a full string if a match is found, splitting the string by a delimiter.

replace_concat_with_cdr_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_cons (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_cdr (regex_split '.' $2)))))))
description: A function that replaces a concatenated substring with the rest of the string after splitting by a delimiter.

vowel_or_consonant_check :: tsubstr
(regex_or 'a' (regex_or 'e' (regex_or 'i' (regex_or 'o' 'u'))))
description: A function that checks if a character is a vowel ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u') or a consonant.

replace_end_letters :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split empty_string $2))))))))
description: A function that replaces the ending letters of a full string with specified substrings.

replace_end_with_substr :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: A function that replaces the end of a full string with a specified substring after splitting by a delimiter.

replace_with_transformed_substrings :: tfullstr -> (tsubstr -> tsubstr) -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map $0 (regex_split '.' $1)))))
description: A function that replaces substrings in a full string with transformed substrings based on a provided transformation function. The full string is split by a delimiter before applying the transformation.

replace_end_with_empty_string_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_split empty_string $1)))))
description: A function that replaces the end of a full string with an empty string after splitting by a delimiter.

replace_start_with_second_letter :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_cons $0 (regex_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: A function that replaces the starting letter of a full string with the second letter after splitting by a delimiter.

add_before_if_match_concat :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_if_match_split $0 (regex_concat $1 $2) $2))))
description: A function that adds a specified substring before a matched substring in a full string by concatenating the substrings.

replace_if_vowel_with_consonant_or_specific :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_if_match_split $0 (regex_concat 'a' $1) $2))))
description: A function that replaces vowels in a full string with a specified consonant or a specific character sequence.
